notes.title: 50% OFF for the Steam Spring Sale! Get RunMan at half price!! Radical!!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921897/b552713e454f3c033facc0ba32016dd6864313da.png[/img]
That's right folks, it's your lucky day, because today is the day you can get your hands on cherished old-school indie platformer RunMan: Race Around the World, without breaking your streak of only buying games on sale. The classic collaboration by Tom Sennett and Maddy Thorson has been ported to modern systems with new Steam achievements, full gamepad support, and all the original's sights, sounds, and charms. Half price is a heckuva deal!!

notes.title: Ready Set Go Patch #1
notes.content:
What up RunFans! Tom Sennett here, your favorite game designer's favorite game designer, saying THANK YOU to everyone who has already helped the Steam launch of RunMan: Race Around the World become a smashing success!

I just pushed an update with a few small fixes:
- Ninja achievement should now activate properly
- Zone 3 boss level (The Twist) gameplay adjusted
- Gamepad button glyphs display in character select menu

Please let me know if you find any other issues or anything else you'd like to see updated. Drop a note in the community hub!

And, a reminder that the game is still on 40% discount until Monday, October 14th. So tell your friends to snag it now!
